name: 曜石黑
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, high-fidelity Chinese Android app and Xiaomi Android home-screen widget concept.
Create a landscape 1536x1024 product design presentation board. Flat, front-facing UI renders, not angled physical phones. One tall complete app screen on the LEFT (about 400px wide and 850px tall); one matching wide 4x2 Android home-screen widget on the RIGHT (about 470px wide by 240px tall), shown at readable larger scale. Clear margins, coherent premium design, restrained composition. On the right include short concept name and 1 short sentence; no huge paragraphs, no extra screens.
Supporting insert image 1 is the actual gray 2022 pre-facelift Lynk & Co 03 vehicle. Composite this car faithfully, preserving its exact body, split headlights, grille, wheels, gray paint, angle and proportions in BOTH app and widget. Do not invent a different model, Tesla, Cybertruck or side-view illustration. Vehicle should have clean edges and be well exposed.
App functions: at top small '蓝牙钥匙', title '领克 03', extremely subtle small status '蓝牙已连接'. Car hero. Exactly TWO equally easy to reach separate primary action buttons with clear unlocked/locked thin line icons and exact text '开锁' and '关锁'. Under close label a very small '同时升窗' annotation is allowed. These are independent push buttons, not a switch or slider. Secondary area below labelled '更多控制', containing exactly four subordinate controls with simple consistent line icons and labels '开窗', '关窗', '后备箱', '洗车'. No decorative or unsupported telemetry: NO range, fuel, battery, air conditioning, ignition, maps, physical lock-state claims, OTA, bottom navigation, fake percentage gauges. No '轻触' usage instructions.
Widget: only '领克 03', same car, discreet '蓝牙钥匙' status/result area, and two easy-to-tap clearly separated '开' and '关' buttons with lock icons. Two primary hit areas. Compact legible widget, no tiny secondary controls.
Chinese typography must be sharp, intentional, correctly spelled, modern sans-serif; hierarchy uses weight/size/whitespace. Avoid generic dashboard clutter. No watermark. This is a visual concept, not a photo. 
STYLE A: Label the board 'A / 曜石黑'. Supporting short sentence '深色车库 · 克制光感'. Neutral medium-dark presentation background, app pure near-black charcoal (#101214), text ivory, subtle platinum surfaces, only tiny cool ice-blue accents. Luxury car-key app with strong editorial typography, very large but dim '03' in the hero background and the vehicle prominent overlapping it. Clean full-bleed hero, not a stack of generic cards. Primary controls: a single long rounded dark graphite control dock with a thin central divider, two large equal left/right zones each with line icon over text. Thin pale blue highlights, no enormous luminous rings. Secondary controls in one quiet 4-column row separated with a hairline. Widget matches: charcoal card with silver title in upper left, car on upper right, two wide charcoal/platinum tactile keys in lower row. Refined premium restraint, high contrast, implementable native Android design.
